structuredContent.governing_intent: Create a single reviewable CANDIDATE design document for the Pre-Python gate operator Control Plane at docs/architecture/pre-python-gate/control-plane.md, limited to architecture/design documentation and local packet/readiness evidence, using the supplied binding authority and cited local baselines without implementing or approving the architecture.
structuredContent.summary: The work packet has a coherent documentation outcome: recover and synthesize the control-plane application model, CLI/web presentation adapter expectations, and observability model into one candidate design artifact with source/invariant mapping, examples, scope limits, and recorded unresolved Founder decisions. The task explicitly forbids implementation, source/test/config changes, service changes, secrets handling, paid execution, and implicit adoption of neighboring candidate documents. Remaining uncertainty is primarily research and drafting work, not unresolved owner intent.
implementation_unknowns: Locate and interpret the cited local source materials, including canonical architecture Operator surface, implementation-plan phases 1–6, interface contracts, Node runtime evidence, EOS materials, and relevant prior control-panel/web work.

Determine the existing documentation conventions for docs/architecture/pre-python-gate and docs/work-units/pre-python-gate so the candidate artifact and evidence packet fit local style and traceability expectations.
Map each required acceptance row and authority section to precise document sections without treating candidate EOS or neighboring draft material as adopted authority.
Decide the best internal structure for the design document, examples, source/invariant mapping, unresolved-decision register, and review checklist.
Identify any unresolved material Founder decisions that emerge from source reconciliation and label them as candidate/unresolved rather than resolving them in the document.
structuredContent.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable through document review: the produced control-plane.md can be checked against G25, G26, G30, Authority §§33,35,36,37 and the stated exclusions. A meaningful independent verdict is possible because a reviewer can verify that the artifact is documentation-only, labels material architecture/security/storage semantics as CANDIDATE, includes source/invariant mappings, successful and failing examples, limitations, unresolved Founder decisions if any, and avoids direct state-edit backdoors, hidden permissions, secrets exposure, implementation edits, or implicit adoption of unapproved neighboring documents.
material_risks: The cited local source corpus may contain tensions between existing Node behavior, prior candidate drafts, and binding Founder authority; these must be recorded or reconciled without inventing approvals.
The document could accidentally overstate candidate design as Founder-approved architecture or API stability if labeling is not disciplined.

Control-plane capabilities such as emit/replay/cancel/reconcile and synthetic-event generation carry security and authority implications that must be framed as candidate semantics requiring Founder approval before implementation where material.
Web control-surface recovery could be misread as approval for a web interface; the packet only permits a candidate design over the same services/policies with explicit approval status.
Observability and diagnostics requirements risk exposing credentials, private reasoning, or sensitive operational details unless sanitized diagnostics boundaries are explicit.
structuredContent.next_action: Proceed with drafting the candidate control-plane design document and local packet/readiness evidence only, using the supplied authority and cited baselines, then obtain independent content review against the acceptance rows and source authority.
structuredContent.rationale: READY is the controlling disposition because the owner intent, scope boundaries, authority limits, and acceptance criteria are sufficiently explicit for autonomous documentation work. The task is cohesive: G25 control-plane application services, G26 presentation adapters, and G30 observability are interdependent aspects of one operator control-plane design and can receive one meaningful independent review verdict. No material owner question must be answered before drafting because the packet instructs the worker to record unresolved Founder decisions rather than silently resolve them. No external prerequisite is established as unavailable; the task states the needed source documents exist in named local baselines. Expected rework is localized to the candidate document and its evidence packet.
